paragraphs: Springbrook sells Cirrus, a multi-tenant SaaS finance platform that users reach from a web browser. The platform is fully integrated with modules including Finance, Payroll, HR, Budgeting, Utility Billing, Tax, Cashless Payments, and Tableau.
The finance product is cloud-based fund accounting software for government. An AI tool links invoices to the appropriate vendor records and removes manual searches and data entry.

Utility billing covers water, sewer, electric, refuse and allocation water billing, connected in real time to an online payment system. The allocation water billing product was designed with the input of California water authorities. These pages describe the buyers as local governments and small to mid sized agencies across the country.

quote.text: Enterprise class Finance Platform software for local government agencies.
